items.title: Purchase a voucher
items.description: Purchase the voucher you want on Unifi.

items.title: Check your purchased voucher
items.description: You can find your vouchers in MY tab > Voucher, and also receive them on LINE if you add Unifi as a friend.

items.title: Get cashback
items.description: After your purchase, 10% of the payment amount is returned as points.

items.title: Use your voucher
items.description: Check where and how to use each product before using it.
